import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        static long MOD = 998244353;
        static long GENERATOR = 3;
        long value;

        Modular(long v) {
            value = v % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        }

        Modular add(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(value + rhs.value);
        }

        Modular sub(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(value - rhs.value + MOD);
        }

        Modular mul(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(value * rhs.value % MOD);
        }

        Modular pow(int exp) {
            Modular base = new Modular(value);
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = result.mul(base);
                base = base.mul(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        Modular inv() {
            return pow((int)(MOD - 2));
        }

        Modular div(Modular rhs) {
            return mul(rhs.inv());
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_SIZE = 10010;
    static Modular[] factorial_table = new Modular[MAX_SIZE];
    static Modular[] inv_factorial_table = new Modular[MAX_SIZE];
    static Modular[] modular_inverse = new Modular[MAX_SIZE];

    static void initialize_factorials() {
        factorial_table[0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            factorial_table[i] = factorial_table[i - 1].mul(new Modular(i));
        }
        inv_factorial_table[MAX_SIZE - 1] = factorial_table[MAX_SIZE - 1].inv();
        for (int i = MAX_SIZE - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_factorial_table[i] = inv_factorial_table[i + 1].mul(new Modular(i + 1));
        }
        for (int i = MAX_SIZE - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            modular_inverse[i] = inv_factorial_table[i].mul(factorial_table[i - 1]);
        }
    }

    static Modular combination(int n, int k) {
        return factorial_table[n].mul(inv_factorial_table[n - k]).mul(inv_factorial_table[k]);
    }

    static Modular binomial_coefficient(int a, int b) {
        return factorial_table[a + b].mul(inv_factorial_table[a]).mul(inv_factorial_table[b]);
    }

    static Modular catalan(int n) {
        if (n < 0) return new Modular(0);
        return binomial_coefficient(n, n).sub(n - 1 >= 0 ? binomial_coefficient(n - 1, n + 1) : new Modular(0));
    }

    static void compute() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        Modular.MOD = sc.nextLong();
        initialize_factorials();

        Modular total = new Modular(0);
        for (int length = 1; length < m; length++) {
            Modular part1 = new Modular(length + 1).pow(length).mul(new Modular(length)).div(new Modular(n - length)).mul(inv_factorial_table[length]);
            for (int i = 0; i < m - length; i++) {
                int j = i + length;
                Modular part2 = new Modular(n - length).pow(i).mul(inv_factorial_table[i]);
                Modular part3 = new Modular(n - j).mul(new Modular(n + 1)).pow(m - 1 - j).mul(factorial_table[j]);
                total = total.add(part1.mul(part2).mul(part3));
            }
        }
        total = total.mul(new Modular(2).pow(m - 1)).mul(new Modular(n + 1 - m));
        System.out.println(total);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        compute();
    }
}
